name: bluechip Notifications and Telegram
description: [bluechip] Notifications created and delivered, delays, notifier errors, push and Telegram.

query.mpl:
`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.notifications.created`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.notifications.delivered`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| where `outcome` == "sent"
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.notifier.errors`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.telegram.messages`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.notifications.created`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `kind` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.notifications.delivered`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `channel`, `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.notifications.delay`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket by `channel` to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.5, 0.95)

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.notifier.errors`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `channel` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.push.subscriptions`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `change` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.telegram.messages`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `direction` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.channels.links`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `change` using sum
